gloss: way of proceeding; approach; method of advancing

definitions.gloss: way of proceeding; approach; how to proceed
definitions.explanation: the method or manner in which something is carried out or advanced

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: To discuss how to proceed with the project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have an opinion about how to run the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}それぞれ→人それぞれ：24844_hitosorezore⟧だ。
examples.english: Everyone has their own approach to work.

notes:
{進|すす}め{方|かた} means "way of proceeding" or "approach to doing something."

COMMON PATTERNS:
Formed with {〜方|かた} (way of doing), a productive suffix attached to verb stems (⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ → {進|すす}め{方|かた}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}: how to proceed with a project
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}: how to run a meeting
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進|すす}め{方|かた}: approach to work
- {進|すす}め{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to discuss how to proceed

- ⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧: way of speaking
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: way of thinking
- ⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧: way of doing
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: way of writing
